verdict.rationale: Feitian documents integration with Azure AD (Entra ID), including passwordless sign-in for Azure AD-joined Windows 10 and Office 365. It also mentions Google Advanced Protection. There is no evidence for Okta or Google Workspace admin integration, and nothing showing admin policies that require hardware-key authentication. missing for 10: Okta integration evidence, Google Workspace (admin) integration docs, policy-enforcement guidance for requiring hardware keys, independent/hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the key integrates with my identity provider — Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace — and I can enforce policies requiring hardware-key authentication

citations.quote: Learn how to use your FEITIAN FIDO2 security key to protect your Azure AD joined Windows 10.
allow users achieve passwordless authentication with the combination of Azure Active Directory (or Office 365 Accounts) and FEITIAN biometric enabled security keys
Introduction about how FEITIAN Security Keys works with Google advanced protection.
